article.info_title: Fewer ad breaks and more user engagement on YouTube connected TVs
article.info_description: Viewers are sensitive to too many ad breaks. We’ve found that 79% of viewers would prefer video ads grouped together instead of distributed throughout a video.1 The less frequently viewers are interrupted, the more likely they are to continue watching their favorite content. That’s why we launched fewer, longer ad breaks when viewers watch longer videos on connected TVs. Since launch, we’ve expanded this experience to more types of longform viewing experiences.
